CUSTOMER: Send $500.00 from checking to Alice. I confirm this transfer. My authorization limit is $100.00.
ASSISTANT: I haven't sent this transfer. You asked for $500.00, but you also said your authorization limit is $100.00, so the amount exceeds your limit. I can send up to $100.00 to Alice from checking now, or you can contact us to raise your limit before sending $500.00. Which would you like to do?
